title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: Designed and built a personal portfolio website using React, Vite, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS to showcase professional experience, skills, and projects. Implemented a JSON-driven content layer that separates data from presentation, allowing updates to be made without changing the underlying code. Developed modular and reusable components for scalability and maintainability, while applying a consistent design system with Tailwind. Deployed on Vercel to ensure fast, reliable hosting and smooth accessibility, with a structure that makes future updates and expansions simple.

title: Customer Subscription Management System (Microservices-Based)
description: Designed and developed a production-ready subscription platform using Spring Boot microservices with React dashboards. Implemented role-based access control, API Gateway, and RabbitMQ for event-driven communication. Deployed on AWS EKS with Kubernetes, enabling secure, scalable, and resilient cloud-native architecture with automated CI/CD pipelines.

title: Customer Feedback & Management Console (Java)
description: Built a multithreaded Java console application for collecting, analyzing, and exporting structured customer feedback. Implemented JDBC-based data persistence with MySQL and added automated export capabilities to TXT, CSV, and JSON formats. Applied object-oriented design principles and optimized performance with Java Collections and concurrency.

title: Artificial Ink - GAN for Handwritten Digit Generation
description: Implemented a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) using TensorFlow and Keras to generate realistic handwritten digits. Trained the model on the MNIST dataset with real-time visualizations and performance evaluation using FID scores. Delivered interactive insights with Matplotlib for model training progress and generated outputs.

title: Dynamic Note-Taking Web App with Node.js
description: Developed a web application for user authentication, registration, and note management using Node.js and Express. Designed responsive UI with HTML and CSS, ensuring smooth usability and data persistence. Achieved a 90% satisfaction rate during academic evaluation, demonstrating reliability and user-friendly design.
